description: i007 (SNAPSHOT=s02, branch=tx-cow-head-realloc) complete. Bounded search of snapshots/s02 only: enumerated all skb_cow_head/skb_cow/skb_unclone/skb_share_check/pskb_expand_head/skb_linearize call sites in net/ and drivers/ (323 matches across 200 files), ran a regex capture-before-realloc/use-after scanner, and deep-read the strongest candidates. Three findings reported as hypotheses (literal source evidence in agent-state/findings/i007.json): (1) net/batman-adv/network-coding.c:1150-1174 (medium) — batadv_nc_code_packets() captures packet1/packet2 as casts of nc_packet->skb->data and skb->data at lines 1118-1132, then skb_linearize(skb_dest)/skb_linearize(skb_src) at 1150 can pskb_expand_head and free the shared head (the stored nc_packet->skb is a skb_clone from the RX path), and the stale pointers are dereferenced at 1160-1174 (packet1->ttl/dest/ttvn, packet2->dest/ttl/ttvn) without refetch; reached from batman_recv_unicast_packet→batadv_route_unicast_packet→batadv_send_skb_to_orig→batadv_nc_skb_forward on attacker-controlled mesh packets. (2) net/batman-adv/routing.c:230-240 (medium) — batadv_recv_my_icmp_packet() captures icmph = (struct batadv_icmp_header *)skb->data at 230, skb_linearize(skb) at 237, then passes the stale icmph to batadv_socket_receive_packet(icmph, skb->len) at 240 which copies header bytes from the possibly-freed old head (net-received BATADV_ICMP handler, main.c:530). (3) net/mac80211/tdls.c:1933-1939 (low) — ieee80211_process_tdls_channel_switch() captures tf = (void *)skb->data at 1923, skb_linearize(skb) at 1933, reads tf->action_code at 1939 through the stale pointer; remote TDLS frames dequeued from the mac80211 worker. Safe counter-examples verified (capture-after-cow or explicit refetch): dsa tag_dsa/edsa/qca/brcm xmit, l2tp_xmit_skb, i2400m_hard_start_xmit, ovs_vport_output, mtk_start_xmit, tg3_start_xmit, tipc link.c:1449 / msg.c:486,551, mac80211 wpa.c/wep.c/rx.c decrypt handlers, batman-adv routing.c:385/816/1042 and network-coding.c:1850. Unresolved (not deep-read, flagged for follow-up): ip_vs_pe_sip.c:85, nf_conntrack_sip.c:1513/1584, xfrm_ipcomp.c:116/182. Limitations: same-function regex scan (no interprocedural pointer tracking), net/+drivers/ only, no runtime KASAN reproducer — reallocation preconditions (cloned/non-linear skb, or cloned nc_packet->skb with network coding enabled) established from pskb_expand_head() semantics (net/core/skbuff.c:1191-1192) and code structure, and ~40 driver TX linearize fallbacks plus non-drivers/net linearize sites (bluetooth, caif, decnet, ndisc, iucv, ovs flow, sctp, qrtr) were pattern-screened but not all line-by-line audited.
